programme.title: BCI Seguros Chile Open (250) D1 R1 S1
programme.desc: The Chile Open is a professional ATP Tour 250 men’s tennis tournament played on outdoor red clay courts in Santiago, Chile. It has roots back to 1930 and is played at the Club Deportivo Universidad Católica in Santiago.
